lucy (customer): Hey team, seeing repeated disconnects + partial outputs from the streaming API when we hit bursty traffic. Sometimes iterator yields an empty string and then stalls on reconnect.

jordan (support): Sorry to hear that — can you paste a short repro and any logs? Is this Py or JS client?

lucy (customer): Primary repro in Python (aiohttp + our wrapper). Happens also in browser with EventSource but less frequently. Repro steps: start a steady stream, then generate a 200ms burst of 50 concurrent requests, many streams return a last chunk that's just "\n" or empty and client retries -> duplicate partial outputs or hang.

jordan (support): Can you share raw SSE frames from a tcpdump or the SDK debug logs?

lucy (customer): snippet from tcpdump (server->client):
```
...\ndata: {"id":"tok_123","choices":[{"delta":"Hello "}]}\n\n
...\ndata: {"choices":[{"delta":"world","finish_reason":null}]}\n\n
```
Frames were split across packets, first packet ends mid-json (no newline), second completes it. Client sometimes emits the second frame alone and drops the first, which leaves the iterator with an empty final chunk on reconnect.

mike (eng-runtime): Interesting — split-frame behavior + backpressure can cause our SSE encoder to flush partial records. Do you have SDK debug where the library prints raw incoming events?

lucy (customer): Yes, Py SDK debug (aiohttp) shows: `Event: "{\"id\":\"tok_123\",\"choices\":[{\"delta\":\"Hello \"}]` then `Event: "}"` which becomes `""` after parsing. This leads to an empty message being queued.

sree (devex): I think this is different from the usual resume-token race. Looks like our client assumes newline-delimited complete JSON for each SSE "data:" event but the server sometimes flushes partial JSON when under pressure.

jordan (support): Workaround request: can you try setting `stream=True` + a small client-side reassembly buffer i.e. read until a valid JSON parse, or `max_line_length` for EventSource?

lucy (customer): We tried buffering on our side and it helps but not reliable across languages. JS EventSource doesn't expose easy reassembly hooks.

mike (eng-runtime): Assigning eng-runtime to investigate server-side emitter: probably a race where we call `flush()` on the encoder too early when the response size > N and kernel TCP pushes two PSH segments. We'll also triage encoder's write semantics to ensure `data:` lines are atomic.

ops-bot: Escalation created: INC-2026-124 (P2) — engineering reviewing streaming emitter behavior.

mike (eng-runtime): Quick repro for us: python3 reproducer.py (attached) that opens 200 SSE clients and sends bursts. Attaches pcap showing split frame at ~2450006722. I can reproduce locally with our runtime in high-concurrency mode.

sree (devex): For SDK short-term fix: in Python/JS/TS SDKs, adjust stream parser to accumulate partial `data:` lines across TCP reads and only attempt JSON parse when the concatenated string yields valid JSON or newline delimiter present. We'll add a small timeout (50ms) to avoid hang on true end-of-event.

jordan (support): Can you add minimal repro logs to the incident (stack traces, event sequence numbers, resume token used)? Also note whether KV-cache/resume-token behavior interacts — if we resume mid-chunk that could produce duplicates.

lucy (customer): FYI we saw duplicated tokens when client retried with same seq number after empty chunk. We had to dedupe on application side.

mike (eng-runtime): Action items: (1) runtime: ensure SSE `data:` writes are flushed per-event (atomic writes) or coalesced correctly; (2) SDKs: implement tolerant reassembly + short parse window; (3) support: notify impacted customers and suggest client-side buffering as stop-gap.

sree (devex): I'll prepare patch for Python and TS SDKs to accumulate partial `data:` values and release a patch. Will include a small unit test simulating split packets.

jordan (support): Thanks — closing loop after call. If anyone sees prolonged hangs after patch, reopen INC.

lucy (customer): Patch test looked good for us in staging. No hangs on reconnect, and duplicates reduced. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-124 updated: eng-runtime assigned, devex patch incoming.

mike (eng-runtime): Moving to eng-runtime backlog with high priority; I'll post a short PR and link once CI reproduces.

sree (devex): preliminary patch: in parser loop do `buffer += chunk; try: json.loads(buffer); emit; buffer = '' except JSONDecodeError: if len(buffer) > 1MB: log and drop; else continue` — and in JS use a similar accumulate+parse with setTimeout(50).

jordan (support): Great — closing loop after call. If anyone sees prolonged hangs after patch, reopen INC.

lucy (customer): Patch test looked good for us in staging. No hangs on reconnect, and duplicates reduced. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
